evidence.title: Agent of Empires README.md
evidence.finding: AoE manages parallel persistent tmux sessions on Linux/macOS, with CLI/TUI/browser/API access, optional worktrees/containers, phone browser access and SSH reconnect. Windows is WSL2 only.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/cli/reference.md
evidence.locator: aoe add; send; ps; agents; acp
evidence.finding: CLI creates, lists, sends to, forks and removes sessions. Custom commands and ACP agent/model/effort selection are supported; named resume/fork examples include Claude, Codex, OpenCode and Pi.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/web-dashboard.md
evidence.finding: The shipped dashboard drives sessions from a browser; tmux and persistent structured workers survive browser crashes. Remote access supports authenticated tunnel modes and read-only views.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/api.md
evidence.finding: HTTP and typed MCP operations expose session management. Authentication and read-only restrictions vary by daemon launch mode.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/mcp-control.md
evidence.finding: MCP control is opt-in, off by default; it exposes session operations under daemon credentials. It adds no per-tool permissions beyond the connected users access.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/mcp-servers.md
evidence.finding: AoE forwards configured MCP server definitions to structured-view agents when a session starts; terminal sessions run the agent's own CLI, which loads MCP configuration itself. This is distinct from AoE's inbound control MCP server.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/sandbox.md
evidence.finding: Optional Docker (default), Podman or Apple Container runs the agent in a private container with the project mounted at /workspace, configurable CPU and memory limits and per-session agent stores. Claude refresh credentials are shared across sandbox sessions, with documented refresh conflicts. The guide documents no network policy settings.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/worktrees.md
evidence.finding: Git worktrees isolate session working copies/branches; they are separate from container security controls.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/session-resume.md
evidence.finding: Resume/fork support depends on harness, store and OS. Codex with ChatGPT login is explicitly refused for managed resume/fork, and unsandboxed macOS Codex has additional limits.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/guides/diff-view.md
evidence.finding: Diff UI supports comparison bases and line comments sent as follow-up prompts. Comments are localStorage per session and move to a stale block when code changes.

evidence.title: Agent of Empires docs/telemetry.md
evidence.finding: Anonymous telemetry is opt-in, off by default. aoe telemetry disable and DO_NOT_TRACK suppress sending; settings expose consent and reset controls.
